dct_description_sm:
The project "Integrated approaches to management of wireworm and Colorado potato beetle in field tomatoes" consisted of three experiments including:

  • TO22T1: Insecticide-herbicide tank mixes on weed control - Determine the impact of tank-mixing common herbicides and foliar insecticides for CPB on product efficacy and crop injury.

  • 22-TOM-CPB-F1: Insecticide-herbicide tank mixes on Colorado potato beetle control - Determine the impact of tank-mixing common herbicides and foliar insecticides use for CPB on product efficacy and crop injury.

  • 22-TOM-WW-G1: Random plant stand loss, cultivar, and planting density on tomato yield - Evaluate the potential for processing tomato planting density as a cultural control tool to mitigate yield loss. This work will also serve to determine the level of uneven plant stand loss required to incur yield losses in processing tomatoes.
dct_title_s: Integrated approaches to management of wireworm and Colorado potato beetle in field tomatoes
